notes.title: CLANNAD is now available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that CLANNAD is now available in Simplified Chinese. A special thank you to everyone for your patience as we put the finishing touches on this update.

The update has already been made live so all you need to do is right click CLANNAD in your library, go to Properties, click on the Languages tab and select Simplified Chinese from the dropdown menu.

On top of that, the retail price for CLANNAD has dropped from $49.99 USD to $44.99 USD!

Finally, fans of Key will want to check out the Kickstarter campaign to fund the localization of Rewrite+ and Harvest festa! There's some great goods available in this campaign so don't miss out.

For more information:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/digital-and-physical-release-of-keys-rewrite/]Rewrite+ & Harvest festa Kickstarter Campaign[/url]

notes.title: CLANNAD build 20180728-2986043
notes.notes:
Release Notes

This is a major patch release for the Steam version and the Kickstarter Limited Edition.

Updated this build
[list]
[*]When changing the protagonist's name in the Name change menu, a confirmation dialog will now appear to give users the option to disable character voices or keep them enabled
[*]An option has been added to the Configuration menu to allow users to disable the opening movie being played on the title screen after idling for a short period of time. This is set to disabled for users with existing saves but is enabled by default for all new users 
[*]Dangopedia code has been overhauled; the 'dangopedia.dbs' file is no longer used
[*]A new entry, "Sakura", has been added to Dangopedia. This entry is unlocked by default upon entering the Dangopedia menu
[*]Some Dangopedia entries' definitions have been edited
[*]Fixed the credits roll images so that all the routes are now using the image that was meant to be used
[*]Ending theme sequence subtitles have been redesigned to improve aesthetics and readability
[/list]

Additional notes - Both versions
[list]
[*]Game saves from the previous versions are expected to continue to function in this version without any issues.
[*]If a save file with the "Sakura" entry unlocked but kept unread is used with the previous versions, a "New!" icon will erroneously appear beneath the last entry of Dangopedia (No.95 "Zoni"). This has no negative effect on gameplay.
[/list]

Additional notes - Steam version
[list]
[*]A 'safe-20160108' branch is available in the Steam game properties menu. If the game is crashing with an older save file and you do not want to start a new game right away, please switch to this branch. We recommend switching back to the default branch as soon as you have completed the current route and returned to the title screen.
[/list]

Additional notes - Kickstarter Limited Edition
[list]
[*]This update contains all changes made in the previous minor patch release for Steam (20170212)
[/list]

Existing Known Issues - Steam version
[list]
[*]Playing the game fullscreen and at 100% window size in Steam will cause notifications and the Steam Overlay to not display
[*]Alt-tabbing out of the game will cause a temporary system lockup and potential game crash
[/list]

Known Issues - Both versions
[list]
[*]For some configurations with the setting "Language for non-Unicode programs" set to "Japanese," the game will fail to launch and create multiple processes of itself
[/list]

notes.title: CLANNAD build 20170212-1626524
notes.notes:
Release Notes

This is a minor patch release for the Steam version.

Updated this build
- Updated engine to version 1.6.7.3
- When playing the game with fonts not supporting the Japanese character set, the game will now automatically display such characters using a bundled Japanese font
- The "Steam/Local" button in the Achievements menu has been replaced with a toggle button
- The Achievements menu no longer displays the Steam user's nickname
- The Achievements menu no longer crashes if the Steam user's nickname contains multi-byte characters

Additional notes for Steam players
- Game saves from the previous versions are expected to continue to function in this version with no issues.
- A new 'safe-20160108' branch is available in the Steam game properties menu. If the game is crashing with an older save file and you do not want to start a new game right away, please switch to this branch. We recommend switching back to the default branch as soon as you have completed the current route and returned to the title screen.

Existing Known Issues - Steam version
- Playing the game fullscreen and at 100% window size in Steam will cause notifications and the Steam Overlay to not display
- Alt-tabbing out of the game will cause a temporary system lockup and potential game crash

Known Issues - Both versions
- For some configurations with the setting "Language for non-Unicode programs" set to "Japanese," the game will fail to launch and create multiple processes of itself

notes.title: CLANNAD 1.01e Update
notes.notes:
Last night we pushed the 1.01e update for CLANNAD. Thanks to everyone's feedback and reports throughout December we were able to get the final bugs and corrections sorted.

The 1.01e update also changes variables and scripting from the previous version, and this unfortunately will break the current save data. To help players who are still working through their current playthrough we have frozen the previous version in a separate "safe" branch. To switch to this branch, open the game's Properties from your library, go to the Betas tab, and select "safe - December 6 version". Switch back to NONE when you are ready to return to the 1.01e update.
